description:
Outcome: Gardeners sign in without passwords (owner sign-in answer; brief.md: Constraints).
Scope: Hashed expiring single-use email tokens, throttling, generic request responses, secure sessions/logout, household association, separately provisioned coordinator role. Excludes: passwords and social login.
Acceptance: Only intended household signs in; expired/replayed tokens fail and concurrent consumption has one winner; link scanner GET cannot consume token before confirmation; email change cannot seize household; gardeners cannot grant roles.
Behaviour: Accessible sent/confirm/expired/resend states; recoverable mail errors; no tokens or contact details in logs. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Expiry/replay/race, rate-limit/enumeration and role tests; captured-email walkthrough. Prerequisites: T-001, T-004, T-003. Assumptions: 15-minute token lifetime.
title: Implement secure emailed one-time sign-in
